task: Harden kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager and kube-scheduler static pods (CIS 5.2.6/5.2.9/5.2.10) via kubeadm patches and an existing-cluster ops script, and enable kubelet protectKernelDefaults (CIS 4.2.6); etcd excluded.

events.summary: Not verified: fresh install and control-plane join with the kubeadm patches, HA/Kakao, node reboot with protectKernelDefaults. etcd is excluded: its patched manifest never started live (root cause open).
Live inventory 2026-11-28 listed the four static pods with KSV001/003/004 and kube-bench CIS 4.2.6 FAIL.
evidence: test:getcap on the kube-apiserver image binary -> cap_net_bind_service=ep

events.summary: kubeadm strategic patches for the three components (drop ALL, no privilege escalation, RuntimeDefault; kube-apiserver keeps NET_BIND_SERVICE, D-CP-APISERVER-FILECAP), wired into init/join; scripts/ops/apply-control-plane-security-context.sh (per --component, backups outside manifests, health from the expected manifest D-CP-HEALTH-EXPECTED, restore on timeout); protectKernelDefaults with sysctls before kubelet and scripts/ops/apply-kubelet-kernel-defaults.sh; exact acceptances for etcd (trial failed) and kube-apiserver KSV022; R426.

evidence: test:kube-scheduler and kube-controller-manager /proc status -> CapEff 0000000000000000, NoNewPrivs 1
test:kube-apiserver after apply -> CapEff 0000000000000400, CapBnd 0000000000000400, NoNewPrivs 1, Seccomp 2; /readyz ok
test:kube-apiserver with drop ALL only (earlier attempt) -> exec /usr/local/bin/kube-apiserver: operation not permitted, restored from backup
test:apply-kubelet-kernel-defaults.sh --apply -> protectKernelDefaults true in /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml and kube-system/kubelet-config; node Ready
test:kube-bench manual run 06:59Z -> 4.2.6 PASS (pass 78 fail 3 warn 44)
test:Trivy configauditreports -> kube-scheduler and kube-controller-manager no KSV001/003/004; kube-apiserver only KSV022 (accepted)
